answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake that vests slowly, and weight its influence by the square root of stake times age. Call the pool the lagoon: funds sit there for 90 days before votes count. Splitting one stake across fifty willow identities gives each only 1/50 of the stake, so total weight falls by about 7x, while the capital stays locked and exposed to slashing if any identity is caught colluding. Each new horizon of reputation must be re-earned, so sybils cost capital, time, and risk.
